timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I keep second-guessing this decision.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I am afraid of choosing the wrong path.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: My mind keeps reopening every possibility.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I want a guarantee before I decide.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels caught between competing options.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I feel responsible for predicting the entire future.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me believes more thinking will create certainty.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that I feel stuck.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This decision is taking up so much space.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can pause the debate for one moment.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: No meaningful choice comes with complete certainty.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can separate real information from imagined outcomes.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I do not have to solve every future consequence today.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can soften while the question remains open.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can notice which values matter most here.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: More thinking is not always more clarity.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can give myself permission to choose imperfectly.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can let the decision become more manageable.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I trust myself to make a thoughtful choice.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I can act on the best information I have now.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I know what matters most to me.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can adjust if new information appears.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can feel grounded as I decide.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I do not need certainty to move forward.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can choose without abandoning myself.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I trust my ability to meet what comes next.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready for one clear next step.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
